value.qualifier: This numerical value is transcribed from main p.6 prose, not estimated from Figure 5a. Main p.6 assigns the near-infrared PL maxima as pristine approximately 1025 nm, 1MA approximately 1035 nm and 2.5MA approximately 1055 nm. Figure 5a on main p.5 instead labels the black pristine maximum rightmost, red 1MA intermediate and green 2.5MA leftmost. The prose and labeled figure therefore disagree on sample assignment/order. Both are retained unresolved; no exact plotted maxima are inferred. This three-peak ordering conflict does not separately contradict the approximately 780 nm 5MA feature or the TRPL panels.

quality.review_scope: All seven main and eight SI pages read as text and faithful images; preparation, four film/device classes, substrate-dependent PL, model controls, tables and source conflicts retained. External cited full recipes and unprinted plot values excluded.
missing_fields: Exact physical batch/aliquot joins, measured atomic coordinates and unprinted curve numbers are not reconstructed.

conflicts: Main p.6 calls the sequence 1025→1035→1055 nm gradually blue-shifted, although those printed wavelengths increase before 780 nm for 5MA. Preserve the verbal claim and numerical sequence.
Figure 5a,b caption and discussion place static/transientPL onmp-Al2O3; main p.6 attribution ofsecondary780nm feature mentions bare mp-TiO2. Do not silently transfer this measurement toTiO2.
SI3 supplies650 nm/10 MHz forTiO2 TRPL; exact pulsed conditions forAl2O3 TRPL are not separately stated.
